architecture_diagram.caption: End-to-end signal flow across Clover Kimi K3's 93-layer MoE trunk/expert pool, K3NativeHybridLink (d=7168), and 11-level parallel NCM decoder.
plans: Here is the architecture diagram showing how Clover Kimi K3 processes multimodal inputs, executes tools, and generates responses in parallel:
Stage 1 (Input & Agent Tools): Accepts text, documents, and images via MoonViT3d and runs live search and Python tools in a 256k context.
Stage 2 (93-Layer Kimi K3 MoE): Runs all 93 Kimi K3 trunks (69 KDA + 24 MLA) and 92 MoE expert layers (d=7168) across GPUs 0 to 5.
Stage 3 & 4 (K3NativeHybridLink + NCM): Maps 7,168-d states through K3NativeHybridLink and decodes 163,840-vocab Kimi K3 tokens in 11 parallel passes.
